features.feature_query: How does the upgrade flow work, including immediate effect and proration?

test_cases.title: Standard upgrade from Starter to Pro mid-cycle applies immediately with correct proration
preconditions: Customer is self-serve and currently on Starter plan
Customer is mid-way through current billing cycle with valid payment method on file
steps: Note days_remaining_in_cycle and total_days_in_cycle for the customer's current cycle
Navigate to plan settings and select upgrade to Pro plan
Confirm the upgrade
Observe plan status and charge applied
test_cases.expected_result: New Pro plan takes effect immediately; customer is charged prorated_charge = (new_plan_price - old_plan_price) * (days_remaining_in_cycle / total_days_in_cycle); next full-price invoice remains scheduled at original billing date

test_cases.title: Upgrade from Pro to Business with successful payment logs plan change
preconditions: Customer is self-serve and currently on Pro plan
Valid payment method on file
steps: Initiate upgrade from Pro to Business plan
Confirm upgrade and successful proration charge
Navigate to Billing history
test_cases.expected_result: Plan change is applied immediately, prorated charge succeeds, and the upgrade event is logged and visible in Billing history per NFR4

test_cases.title: Upgrade at the very start of billing cycle results in near-maximum proration charge
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
Current billing cycle just started (days_remaining_in_cycle ≈ total_days_in_cycle)
steps: Initiate upgrade to Pro plan on day 1 of billing cycle
Confirm upgrade
Check the charged amount
test_cases.expected_result: Prorated charge approximately equals full price difference (new_plan_price - old_plan_price), since days_remaining_in_cycle is nearly equal to total_days_in_cycle

test_cases.title: Upgrade with fewer than 24 hours remaining in billing cycle calculates minimal proration
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
Current billing cycle has less than 24 hours remaining (days_remaining_in_cycle is a very small fraction, e.g. 0.5)
steps: Initiate upgrade to Pro plan with less than 1 day remaining in cycle
Confirm upgrade
Check the charged amount
test_cases.expected_result: System correctly calculates a small but non-error prorated_charge using the fractional days_remaining_in_cycle value without failure or rounding errors

test_cases.title: Upgrade attempted with zero days remaining in billing cycle
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
Current billing cycle has exactly 0 days remaining (last moment of cycle)
steps: Initiate upgrade to Pro plan with days_remaining_in_cycle = 0
Confirm upgrade
Check the charged amount and resulting plan state
test_cases.expected_result: Prorated charge is calculated as zero (or minimal) without division/calculation errors; new plan still takes effect immediately

test_cases.title: Grandfathered-pricing customer sees irreversibility warning before upgrading
preconditions: Customer is on a grandfathered pricing plan
Customer initiates an upgrade action
steps: Navigate to plan settings as a grandfathered-pricing customer
Select an upgrade to a standard-priced plan
Observe any warning messages presented before confirmation
test_cases.expected_result: System displays an explicit irreversibility warning informing the customer that upgrading will forfeit their grandfathered pricing permanently, requiring explicit confirmation before proceeding

test_cases.title: Plan catalog misconfiguration: 'upgrade' target is actually cheaper than current plan
preconditions: Customer is on a plan labeled 'Pro'
Catalog is misconfigured so the plan labeled as an upgrade tier has a lower price than current plan
steps: Initiate what the UI labels as an 'upgrade' to the misconfigured cheaper plan
Confirm the change
Observe how the system processes the plan change
test_cases.expected_result: System compares prices, determines this is actually a downgrade by price, and applies downgrade flow (deferred effect, no credit) rather than immediate-effect upgrade logic

test_cases.title: Concurrent plan-change request while a previous request is still processing
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
A previous plan-change request (e.g. upgrade to Pro) is currently in progress/pending
steps: Initiate a second plan-change request (e.g. upgrade to Business) before the first request completes
Observe system behavior
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents or queues the second plan-change request until the first completes, avoiding partial or conflicting plan states

test_cases.title: Failed payment during upgrade leaves customer on original plan
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
Customer's payment method will be declined (e.g. test card configured to decline)
steps: Initiate upgrade from Starter to Pro
Confirm upgrade, triggering prorated charge attempt
Payment processor declines the charge
Observe resulting plan state and UI messaging
test_cases.expected_result: Plan change does not take effect; customer remains on Starter plan with no partial state change; inline error is shown with decline reason (if provided) and a link to update payment method

test_cases.title: Failed payment during upgrade with no decline reason provided by processor
preconditions: Customer is on Pro plan
Payment processor will fail the charge without providing a specific decline reason
steps: Initiate upgrade from Pro to Business
Confirm upgrade, triggering prorated charge attempt
Payment processor fails the transaction without a decline reason
Observe resulting plan state and UI messaging
test_cases.expected_result: Plan change does not take effect; customer remains on original plan; inline error is shown (generic failure messaging since no decline reason available) with link to update payment method

test_cases.title: Attempt to upgrade with no payment method on file
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
No valid payment method is on file for the customer
steps: Initiate upgrade from Starter to Pro
Attempt to confirm the upgrade
test_cases.expected_result: Prorated charge attempt fails due to missing payment method; plan change does not take effect; customer remains on original plan with inline error directing them to add a payment method

test_cases.title: Upgrade log entry is created and visible in Billing history even for immediate-effect change
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan with valid payment method
steps: Perform a successful upgrade from Starter to Pro
Navigate to Billing history section
test_cases.expected_result: A log entry for the plan change (upgrade) is present in Billing history, including relevant details per NFR4 logging requirements

test_cases.title: Failed upgrade payment does not create an erroneous plan-change log entry indicating success
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
Payment method will be declined
steps: Initiate upgrade from Starter to Pro
Payment fails during proration charge
Navigate to Billing history
test_cases.expected_result: Billing history reflects the failed upgrade attempt (or no successful plan-change entry) without indicating the customer moved to Pro plan; customer's plan remains Starter

test_cases.title: Upgrade from Business (highest tier) attempted where no higher plan exists
preconditions: Customer is on Business plan, the highest available tier
No higher-priced plan exists in the catalog
steps: Navigate to plan settings
Attempt to find or select an upgrade option beyond Business
test_cases.expected_result: System does not present a further upgrade option; no erroneous upgrade action is possible since no higher-priced plan is available

features.feature_query: How does the downgrade flow work, including deferred effect and no credit?

test_cases.title: Standard downgrade from Pro to Starter defers to next billing cycle
preconditions: Customer is self-serve and on Pro plan
Customer is mid-way through current billing cycle
steps: Log in as the customer
Navigate to plan management page
Select downgrade to Starter plan
Confirm the downgrade action
test_cases.expected_result: Customer retains Pro-level access until the end of the current billing cycle; Starter plan is scheduled to begin at the next billing date; no credit is issued.

test_cases.title: Downgrade confirmation clearly communicates no credit and deferred timing
preconditions: Customer is self-serve and on Business plan
steps: Navigate to plan management page
Select downgrade to Pro plan
View confirmation dialog before finalizing
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation dialog states current plan access continues until end of billing cycle, new plan starts next cycle, and no credit will be issued.

test_cases.title: Downgrade at exact end of billing cycle takes effect on schedule
preconditions: Customer is on Pro plan
Current date is the last day of the billing cycle
steps: Initiate downgrade from Pro to Starter
Wait for billing cycle rollover to occur
Check plan status after rollover
test_cases.expected_result: Downgrade takes effect exactly at the next billing date; Starter plan access begins with no credit issued for the prior cycle.

test_cases.title: Customer upgrades again before a pending downgrade takes effect - downgrade is cancelled, not stacked
preconditions: Customer is on Pro plan
Customer has already scheduled a downgrade to Starter effective next billing cycle
steps: Navigate to plan management page
Select upgrade to Business plan before the pending downgrade takes effect
Confirm the upgrade
Check billing history and plan status
test_cases.expected_result: The pending downgrade to Starter is cancelled entirely (not stacked or queued); the upgrade to Business applies immediately with correct proration.

test_cases.title: Downgrade then downgrade again before cycle end replaces the earlier pending downgrade
preconditions: Customer is on Business plan
Customer has a pending downgrade to Pro scheduled for next cycle
steps: Navigate to plan management page
Select downgrade to Starter instead
Confirm the new downgrade selection
Check pending plan change status
test_cases.expected_result: Only one pending downgrade exists at a time; the pending change is updated to Starter (replacing Pro) with no credit issued, effective next billing cycle.

test_cases.title: Downgrade logged and visible in Billing history
preconditions: Customer is on Pro plan
steps: Initiate downgrade to Starter
Confirm the downgrade
Navigate to Billing history page
test_cases.expected_result: Billing history shows an entry recording the downgrade request, effective date, and confirmation of no credit issued.

test_cases.title: Grandfathered-pricing customer sees irreversibility warning before downgrading
preconditions: Customer is on a grandfathered legacy pricing plan
steps: Navigate to plan management page
Select downgrade to a standard lower-tier plan
Review warning message shown before confirmation
test_cases.expected_result: System displays an explicit warning that leaving grandfathered pricing is irreversible before allowing the customer to confirm the downgrade.

test_cases.title: Downgrade with active coupon/discount does not trigger credit or incorrect proration
preconditions: Customer is on Pro plan with an active discount code applied
steps: Navigate to plan management page
Select downgrade to Starter plan
Confirm the downgrade
Check billing history and account balance
test_cases.expected_result: No credit or proration calculation is applied for the downgrade regardless of active discount; discount continues to apply to remaining current-cycle access as expected until cycle end.

test_cases.title: Attempt to downgrade while account currency differs from plan pricing currency
preconditions: Customer's account currency is not USD
Target lower-tier plan is only priced in USD (promotional plan)
steps: Navigate to plan management page
Attempt to select downgrade to the USD-only promotional plan
Observe system response
test_cases.expected_result: System handles currency mismatch appropriately (e.g., blocks selection or converts/display clarifies pricing) without allowing an inconsistent or broken billing state.

test_cases.title: Non-self-serve customer cannot access downgrade flow without support
preconditions: Customer account is flagged as non-self-serve / enterprise-managed
steps: Log in as the customer
Navigate to plan management page
Attempt to initiate a downgrade
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents self-serve downgrade and directs the customer to contact support, consistent with acceptance criteria scope limited to self-serve customers on Starter, Pro, and Business.

test_cases.title: Downgrade request fails to cancel a pending upgrade improperly (no invalid stacked state)
preconditions: Customer is on Starter plan
Customer has just initiated an upgrade to Pro that is still processing
steps: While upgrade to Pro is processing, attempt to initiate a downgrade back to Starter
Observe system behavior
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents an invalid stacked/conflicting state; either blocks the downgrade until upgrade resolves or clearly cancels/replaces the pending change consistently, with no partial or corrupted plan state.

test_cases.title: Downgrade does not issue credit even when customer requests one via support-style workaround
preconditions: Customer is on Business plan
Customer submits downgrade and separately attempts to request a credit for unused time
steps: Initiate downgrade to Starter
Confirm downgrade
Check account balance and billing history for any credit issuance
test_cases.expected_result: No credit is issued under any circumstance for the downgrade, per policy preventing gaming of downgrade/upgrade cycles.

test_cases.title: Downgrade scheduling fails gracefully on backend error, leaving customer on current plan
preconditions: Customer is on Pro plan
Billing system is simulated to return an error when scheduling the deferred downgrade
steps: Initiate downgrade to Starter
Confirm the downgrade while backend scheduling error is simulated
Observe system response and plan status
test_cases.expected_result: Customer remains fully on Pro plan with no partial state change; an error message is shown indicating the downgrade could not be scheduled, and no downgrade entry appears in Billing history as completed.

features.feature_query: How does switching between monthly and annual billing work?

test_cases.title: Switch from monthly to annual billing successfully
preconditions: Customer is on an active monthly billing plan
Customer is mid-way through their current monthly cycle
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Select the annual billing option for the current plan
Confirm the billing cycle switch
test_cases.expected_result: Customer is immediately charged the annual rate, prorated by crediting the unused portion of the current monthly cycle against the annual charge. Billing cycle is updated to annual.

test_cases.title: Attempt to switch from annual to monthly mid-cycle
preconditions: Customer is on an active annual billing plan
Customer is mid-cycle (not at renewal date)
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Attempt to select monthly billing option
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents the switch and informs the customer they must wait until their annual renewal date to switch to monthly billing.

test_cases.title: Switch from annual to monthly at renewal date
preconditions: Customer is on an active annual billing plan
Customer's annual renewal date is today, before the renewal charge has fired
steps: Log in as the customer on their renewal date
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Select monthly billing option
Confirm the billing cycle switch
test_cases.expected_result: Customer is switched to monthly billing and the renewal charge reflects the monthly rate instead of the annual rate.

test_cases.title: View monthly and annual pricing in plan comparison modal
preconditions: Customer has an active subscription
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
test_cases.expected_result: Modal displays all available plans side by side, current plan highlighted, each showing both monthly and annual pricing along with a feature comparison table.

test_cases.title: Switch to annual billing on the last day of the monthly cycle
preconditions: Customer is on an active monthly billing plan
Customer is on the final day of their current monthly cycle (0-1 days remaining)
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Select annual billing option
Confirm the switch
test_cases.expected_result: Annual rate is charged immediately with a minimal or near-zero proration credit reflecting the negligible unused portion of the monthly cycle.

test_cases.title: Switch to annual billing on the first day of the monthly cycle
preconditions: Customer is on an active monthly billing plan
Customer just started a new monthly cycle (full days remaining)
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Select annual billing option
Confirm the switch
test_cases.expected_result: Annual rate is charged immediately with the maximum possible proration credit applied, reflecting nearly the full unused monthly cycle.

test_cases.title: Attempt annual-to-monthly switch exactly at renewal charge firing time
preconditions: Customer is on annual billing
Customer's renewal charge is in the process of firing (race condition scenario)
steps: Log in as the customer at the exact moment renewal processing begins
Click 'Change plan' and attempt to select monthly billing
test_cases.expected_result: System either allows the switch only if it strictly precedes the renewal charge, or blocks the switch and applies the annual renewal charge as normal; no double-charging or inconsistent state occurs.

test_cases.title: Switch from monthly to annual combined with a plan upgrade
preconditions: Customer is on monthly billing for the Starter plan
Customer is mid-cycle
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Select the Pro plan with annual billing
Confirm the change
test_cases.expected_result: Customer is charged the Pro annual rate immediately, with proration crediting the unused portion of the current monthly cycle against the new annual charge.

test_cases.title: Switch to annual billing when unused monthly credit exceeds annual charge
preconditions: Customer is on a high-priced monthly plan just billed at the start of the cycle
Annual plan price is low relative to the unused monthly credit
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' to open the plan comparison modal
Select annual billing option
Confirm the switch
test_cases.expected_result: System correctly calculates and applies the proration credit; if credit exceeds the annual charge, the resulting charge is handled per proration rule (e.g., charge floored at zero or remaining credit applied/documented) without resulting in a negative charge to the customer.

test_cases.title: Reject monthly-to-annual switch for customer with no active subscription
preconditions: Customer account exists but has no active subscription (e.g., canceled or expired)
steps: Log in as the customer
Attempt to open the plan comparison modal via 'Change plan'
Attempt to select annual billing
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents the billing cycle change and displays an appropriate error indicating there is no active subscription to modify.

test_cases.title: Reject direct annual-to-monthly switch attempt via API bypassing UI restriction
preconditions: Customer is on active annual billing
Customer is mid-cycle
Customer attempts to call the billing change endpoint directly instead of using the UI
steps: Authenticate as the customer
Send a direct API request to switch billing cycle from annual to monthly mid-cycle
test_cases.expected_result: API rejects the request with an error indicating the switch is not allowed until the annual renewal date, consistent with UI behavior.

test_cases.title: Handle payment failure during monthly-to-annual proration charge
preconditions: Customer is on monthly billing, mid-cycle
Customer's payment method on file is invalid or has insufficient funds
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan' and select annual billing
Confirm the switch
Payment processor declines the prorated annual charge
test_cases.expected_result: Billing cycle switch is not completed; customer remains on monthly billing; system displays a payment failure error and prompts to update payment method.

test_cases.title: Duplicate/rapid double-submission of billing cycle switch request
preconditions: Customer is on active monthly billing
Customer initiates the switch to annual billing
steps: Log in as the customer
Click 'Change plan', select annual billing, and click confirm multiple times rapidly before the first request completes
test_cases.expected_result: Only one billing cycle switch and one prorated annual charge is processed; duplicate submissions are ignored or blocked, preventing double charging.

features.feature_query: What happens when a payment fails during a plan change?

test_cases.title: Successful upgrade with valid prorated charge
preconditions: Customer is on an active Starter plan
Customer has a valid, working payment method on file
steps: Customer navigates to plan change screen
Customer selects Pro plan (upgrade)
Customer confirms the upgrade and the prorated charge amount
System attempts to charge the prorated amount via Stripe
test_cases.expected_result: Payment succeeds, plan change takes effect immediately, database and Stripe subscription are updated consistently, confirmation email is sent with new plan, effective date, and prorated amount charged, and confirmation screen is shown in-app.

test_cases.title: Card declined during upgrade charge
preconditions: Customer is on an active Starter plan
Customer's card will be declined by the payment processor
steps: Customer navigates to plan change screen
Customer selects Pro plan (upgrade)
Customer confirms the upgrade
System attempts to charge the prorated amount via Stripe
Stripe declines the charge due to insufficient funds
test_cases.expected_result: Plan change does not take effect; customer remains on Starter plan; inline error is displayed showing the decline reason returned by the payment processor along with a link to update payment method.

test_cases.title: Card declined with no reason provided by processor
preconditions: Customer is on an active Starter plan
Customer's card will be declined without a specific decline reason from the processor
steps: Customer navigates to plan change screen
Customer selects Pro plan (upgrade)
Customer confirms the upgrade
System attempts to charge the prorated amount via Stripe
Stripe declines the charge without returning a specific reason code
test_cases.expected_result: Plan change does not take effect; customer remains on Starter plan; inline error is shown (generic decline message since no reason provided) with a link to update payment method.

test_cases.title: Stripe charge succeeds but database write fails
preconditions: Customer is on an active Starter plan
Customer has a valid payment method
Simulate a database write failure after successful Stripe API call
steps: Customer initiates upgrade to Pro plan
Stripe successfully processes the prorated charge
Application database write for the plan change fails
Webhook retry mechanism is triggered
test_cases.expected_result: System reconciles the inconsistency via webhook retry so the database eventually reflects the successful Stripe charge and plan change; customer is not left in an inconsistent state (e.g. charged but still on old plan indefinitely).

test_cases.title: Plan change attempted while previous change still processing
preconditions: Customer is on an active plan
A previous plan-change request for this account is still processing
steps: Customer submits a new plan-change request while the prior request has not yet completed
System detects the in-flight request for the same account
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents the race condition from corrupting state — either rejects/queues the second request until the first resolves, or handles it gracefully without creating duplicate or conflicting plan changes.

test_cases.title: Upgrade with $0.00 prorated charge on last day of cycle
preconditions: Customer is on an active plan
Customer attempts an upgrade on the last day of the billing cycle where the prorated charge computes to $0.00 due to rounding
steps: Customer navigates to plan change screen on the last day of the billing cycle
Customer selects a new plan resulting in $0.00 prorated charge
Customer confirms the plan change
System processes the $0.00 charge (or bypasses actual payment processor call)
test_cases.expected_result: Plan change is treated as valid and takes effect; no payment failure occurs since there is no actual charge; confirmation email is sent and confirmation screen shown reflecting $0.00 charged.

test_cases.title: Downgrade does not trigger a payment charge or failure
preconditions: Customer is on an active Pro plan
Customer wants to downgrade to Starter plan
steps: Customer navigates to plan change screen
Customer selects Starter plan (downgrade)
Customer confirms the downgrade
test_cases.expected_result: No prorated charge is attempted since downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle with no credit issued; customer retains Pro access until end of current cycle; no payment failure scenario applies.

test_cases.title: Retry upgrade after updating payment method following a decline
preconditions: Customer previously attempted an upgrade that failed due to a declined card
Customer remains on their original plan after the failure
steps: Customer clicks the link to update payment method shown in the inline error
Customer enters valid payment details and saves them
Customer retries the plan upgrade
System attempts the prorated charge again via Stripe
test_cases.expected_result: Charge succeeds with the updated payment method, plan change takes effect, database and Stripe are updated consistently, and confirmation email/screen are shown.

test_cases.title: Currency mismatch between account currency and promotional pricing
preconditions: Customer's account currency differs from the currency of an applicable promotional price
Customer attempts to upgrade using the promotional offer
steps: Customer navigates to plan change screen
Customer selects a plan with a promotional price in a different currency than their account currency
Customer confirms the upgrade
System attempts to process the charge
test_cases.expected_result: System handles the currency mismatch appropriately without corrupting billing state (exact resolution not specified in PRD); at minimum, plan change should not silently succeed with incorrect currency charged, and any failure should show an inline error with available decline reason and link to update payment method.

test_cases.title: Insufficient funds decline preserves original plan entitlements
preconditions: Customer is on an active Starter plan
Customer's card has insufficient funds for the upgrade charge
steps: Customer initiates upgrade to Pro plan
System attempts prorated charge
Charge fails due to insufficient funds
test_cases.expected_result: Customer's original Starter plan access and entitlements remain unchanged; no partial upgrade or feature access granted; inline error with decline reason and link to update payment method is displayed.

test_cases.title: No confirmation email sent when payment fails
preconditions: Customer is on an active Starter plan
Customer's card will be declined
steps: Customer initiates upgrade to Pro plan
System attempts prorated charge which fails
Observe email notifications sent to customer
test_cases.expected_result: No plan-change confirmation email is sent since the plan change did not succeed; only the inline error is shown in-app.
